meta.scope_note: Revised ENT membership supplied explicitly for family evaluation; journey percentages are observational only when a 111 Online journey dataset is supplied.

journey_metrics.reason: No observed 111 Online journey CSV was supplied. These metrics cannot be derived from deterministic Pathways structure alone.

definitions.coverage_percentage: Observed 111 Online journeys whose first pathway is in Revised ENT, as a percentage of all journeys in the supplied dataset.
definitions.e2e_completion_within_group_percentage: Journeys starting in Revised ENT whose final pathway is also in Revised ENT, whether or not they temporarily left the family.
definitions.same_start_finish_pathway_percentage: Journeys starting in Revised ENT whose final pathway equals their first pathway.
definitions.start_finish_ent_no_unsupported_percenta: Journeys starting and finishing in Revised ENT where every observed pathway in the sequence is also in Revised ENT.
definitions.start_finish_ent_with_unsupported_percen: Journeys starting and finishing in Revised ENT that visit at least one pathway outside Revised ENT before returning.
definitions.finish_handover_out_of_scope_percentage: Journeys starting in Revised ENT whose final observed pathway is outside Revised ENT.
